create_text_labels: create formatted text labels from class ids, scores, and class names for visualization
draw_one_frame: draw predicted labels and bounding boxes on a single video frame with configurable alpha
draw_clip: draw predictions on a video clip with fade-in and fade-out effects around a keyframe
draw_clip_range: draw predictions on a subset of video frames within a specified range with slow-motion repeat
draw_multiple_text: draw a list of text labels around a bounding box on an image with auto alignment
